article.title: When to stop reading a book
article.excerpt: Kelly Jane Torrance has a very good article on this question. This part is quoting yours truly: "People have this innate view – it comes from friendship and marriage – that commitment is good. Which I agree with," he says. That view shouldn't, he says, carry over to inanimate objects. It's not that he's not a voracious reader – he finishes more than a book
